title: Kicked Mustardy Jamaican Courgettes Skillet
description: A light and flavorful Jamaican dish featuring courgettes, perfect for kids and adults alike, with a tangy mustardy taste and a crunchy pickle topping.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced courgettes and cook until they start to soften, about 4 minutes.
Sprinkle the Jamaican jerk seasoning, salt, and black pepper over the courgettes and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until the courgettes are tender.
Stir in the Dijon mustard and pickle relish.
Serve hot, garnished with additional pickle relish if desired.
Let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as rice or bread.
